summary.intent: Deploy v0.25.1 to staging and investigate two performance/reliability issues found during smoke testing: slow IPNS publish (30s+) and broken token refresh causing 401s.
summary.outcome: v0.25.1 tagged and released, staging deployment triggered. Both root causes identified and fixed; IPNS fix committed to a branch with PR pending creation, token refresh fix deferred for deeper review.

repo: The app has two parallel API client systems: orval-generated fetch client (custom-instance.ts) and an axios client (lib/api/client.ts). Only the axios client had 401/refresh interceptors, leaving the fetch client unprotected.
IpnsService.publishRecord() was awaiting DHT propagation via someguy sidecar, but resolveRecord() always prefers the DB cache — making DHT await unnecessary for correctness.
Access tokens expire in 15 minutes; long-running sessions (e.g., batch operations) expose the missing refresh logic.
Grafana Cloud free-tier instances hibernate after inactivity and return HTTP 503 'instance is loading' on wake — provisioning failures in CI are likely transient.

code.finding: result variable stays 'success' after fire-and-forget change since delegated routing errors no longer mutate it — correct because DB write is the authoritative publish step.
Orval-generated fetch client had zero 401 handling; fix adds refresh-and-retry logic using a new shared token-refresh module.
Axios client used only during login/vault init; token refresh interceptor was only here, not in the primary orval fetch client.

workflow: Parallel subagent spawning is used for independent bug investigations to preserve main context and get concurrent results.
release-please title pattern needed a fix (PR #307) — manual tag/release creation was required for v0.25.1 as a workaround.
Tag Staging Release GitHub Actions workflow gates deployment behind staging-approval after E2E tests.

friction: release-please title pattern was misconfigured, requiring manual tag and GitHub release creation for v0.25.1.
Grafana Cloud staging provisioning step fails transiently on CI due to free-tier hibernation, creating noise in deploy pipelines.
Stale background task notification from a previous session surfaced mid-conversation (benign but distracting).
open_items: Token refresh fix (Issue 2) deferred for deeper investigation — root cause identified but user wants to review before committing.
PR for IPNS publish fix was being created at transcript end — not yet merged or deployed to staging.
Grafana provisioning transient failure was not resolved — options were re-run or ignore; no permanent fix applied.
Batch delete performance should be re-tested on staging after IPNS fire-and-forget fix is deployed to confirm improvement.
